On Thursday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Kate and Nina are preparing a report about the green hill. Workers fitted the steel skeleton of the tower.

Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Nina thanked Kate for the honest advice. What's more, replace the broken caster under the wobbly office chair.

People around Nina often share different ideas about the green hill. Nina has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term. Nina plans to study math harder this term. The morning was close and muggy.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The camping site has become an important part of daily life. For example, acid rain kills trees.
At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening.
